crossRefs.note: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and…
When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his…
It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he…
They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of…
Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not…
that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of…
In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is…
Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

translations.web: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
translations.bsb: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
translations.kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
translations.asv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed as with the drought of summer. Selah
